title: Jace Callaway's 1980s hypothesis that DMT is produced during sleep and dreams

tellings.quote: that one I think is just that was just again a hypothesis put out by a guy called Jace Callaway in the 1980s.

plain: A researcher named Andrew Gallimore says on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in 2025 that the idea that the body makes DMT, a powerful psychedelic substance, during sleep and dreams goes back to a man named Jace Callaway in the 1980s. Gallimore stresses that it was only ever a hypothesis Callaway put forward, an idea that, if true, would tie ordinary dreaming to the DMT experience.
